Method of Attack: Phishing campaign delivering malicious PowerShell script
PowerShell reconnaissance script gathering network and system information
Repeated connections to command and control (C2) server to receive and execute additional PowerShell scripts
Use of scheduled tasks for persistence
Reconnaissance to identify high-value targets for ransomware attacks (Ryuk, Conti)
